translations.web: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from Yahweh.
translations.bsb: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.
translations.kjv: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD.
translations.asv: The lot is cast into the lap; But the whole disposing thereof is of Jehovah.
